configuration.optimizer: fused AdamW with FP32 adapter parameters and state

measurement_limits: Own interruption/resume stays within each arm's no-AC execution policy. Full-versus-none equality is an allocated observational comparison with exactly three acknowledged execution-metadata leaf differences; it does not permit production resume across execution policies.

Native checkpoint comparisons establish zero-tolerance model/optimizer tensor values and exact RNG/data/control state with the listed publication-field exclusions. Per-adapter tensor-byte equality is established separately for own DCP/portable probes; literal optimizer bytes and serialized DCP byte identity are not claimed.

Numerical update comparison excludes timer/preprocessing counters and reporting-history grad_clip_fraction. Four updates and validation on four rows at steps 0/2/4 do not establish 300-update performance, late recovery, product quality, or release readiness.
This evidence does not change the default full activation-checkpointing policy or supported model/hardware/distribution/shape scope.
sampled_memory_scope: Aggregate parent-interval sampling across both lifecycle phases and their probes/comparisons. The 2,322 records include one incomplete host row; sampled peaks are lower bounds. Sampling does not cover the complete allocation, establish complete allocator/cgroup/physical-host accounting, or provide matched per-arm/policy memory or speed comparisons.
